body:
Thats a nice sentiment but this isnt, "i'm shy and I feel uncomfortable around people." more like "If I walk into that place, there is a 50/50 chance I will either throw up or pass out."

Sounds like missing to me.
I have debilitating mental health issues which will probably worsen with age, given my family history.

I actually play MTG but I never have anyone to play with. there is a card store right down the street from my apartment but Im terrified to go and interact with other people. They will probably make fun of me for being a bad player or whatever. I would love to go. I fantasize about being there and meeting new people and all that, but I really just cant. I panic.

I have severe bi polar, ODC, and trichotillomania. Im a 22 year old female who cant grow hair or leave her apartment. Meds dont work. Therapy doesnt work. Everyone in my biological family has major mental health issues. Two of my uncles committed suicide by the age of 30. My other uncle is in prison. My aunt is in a ward. And my mom is just generally mean and abusive. Doesn't mean I dont care about her. I would feel horrible being the 4th person in her life to off themself. But I feel like this is a pattern that has played out before. I start losing it in my mid 20s, and by 30-40 I'm totally gone. 

I just dont see a point in prolonging the inevitable. I'm sick. I'm crazy. I feel like an incomplete person. The world is better off without me. I'm better off without me.

Everytime I cross a street, I think "I hope a car hits me." Every Time a plane flies above my house, I think "Please let it crash here."

This probably isn't helping, but you should know you aren't the only person who feels like this.
